# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "Visual Studio Code" text
  - Center: "Welcome - project - Visual Studio Code" text
  - Right: Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

- **System Information Bar**
  - Center: "Oct 23 01:56" timestamp
  - Right: System tray icons (network, sound, power)

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Explorer Panel**
  - Title: "EXPLORER"
  - Expandable folder: "PROJECT" (expanded state)
  - File list:
    - `README.md` (with information icon)
    - `test_text_search.py` (with Python file icon)
    - `text_search.py` (with Python file icon)
  - Action buttons (top right of Explorer panel):
    - New file icon
    - New folder icon
    - Refresh icon
    - Source control icon

- **Activity Bar (Vertical Icons)**
  - Search icon
  - Source control icon
  - Debug icon
  - Extensions icon
  - Settings icon (with notification badge "1")
  - Outline panel toggle
  - Timeline panel toggle

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Page**
  - Title: "Visual Studio Code"
  - Subtitle: "Editing evolved"

- **Start Section**
  - "Start" heading
  - List of actions:
    - "New File..." (with document icon)
    - "Open File..." (with folder icon)
    - "Open Folder..." (with folder icon)
    - "Connect to..." (with cloud icon)

- **Recent Section**
  - "Recent" heading
  - Message: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."

- **Walkthroughs Section**
  - "Walkthroughs" heading
  - "Get Started with VS Code" (with star icon)
    - Description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding"
    - Status: Highlighted with blue underline
  - "Learn the Fundamentals" (with lightbulb icon)

## Status Bar (Bottom)

- **Left Side**
  - Source control status indicators (with zero counts)
  - Git branch indicator (if applicable)

- **Right Side**
  - Checkbox: "Show welcome page on startup" (checked)
  - Notification bell icon

## Dock (Left Side)

- **Application Icons**
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code (active)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## Additional UI Elements

- **Tab Bar**
  - Active tab: "Welcome" (with close button "X")

- **Window Controls**
  - Minimize, maximize, close buttons in top-right corner

- **Activity Indicator**
  - "Activities" text in top-left corner

- **System Tray**
  - Icons for network, sound, and power in top-right corner

- **Notification Bell**
  - Located in the top-right corner of the window

- **Grid Icon**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the dock

- **User Profile Icon**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the sidebar

- **Settings Icon**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the sidebar, with a notification badge "1"

- **Outline and Timeline Panel Toggles**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the sidebar

- **Status Indicators**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the status bar

- **Welcome Page Checkbox**
  - Located at the bottom-right corner of the main content area

- **Notification Bell Icon**
  - Located at the bottom-right corner of the status bar

- **Source Control Status Indicators**
  - Located at the bottom-left corner of the status bar

- **Git Branch Indicator**

  - Located on the left side of the window
